input.name: fold12
input.source: the same Rust preprocess_hcqt_window(..., 'fold12') tensor the retrieval backbone consumes
input.bin0_pitch_class: G (MIDI pc 7). chroma_index = (midi_pc - 7) mod 12 — the same G-based fold12 frame your worker captures pre-KeyCanon. Do NOT rotate before the call.
input.drone_subtraction: MUST NOT be applied. Trained on plain fold12 (Rust pool_mode fold12, no per-bin floor subtraction). Capture BEFORE your stationary-drone floor subtraction — that step removes sustained tonic energy, the most informative feature for this task, and feeding subtracted input is an out-of-distribution error that degrades silently.

output.name: tonic_logits
output.index_meaning: MIDI pitch class, 0 = C (the export folds the G-frame rotation into the graph; consumer does no rotation on either side)

metric_caveat: within-a-fifth (80%) would NOT detect a constant fifth offset from a bin-origin mismatch; validate absolute agreement on a known-key clip first (e.g. a clip your KeyCanon+melodicFit pipeline is confident about).
training: round-5 fullcorpus shard, balance_pow=0.5 focal_gamma=1.5; held-out 76.5% vs 32.3% marginal; B-key 66% (v1: 24%)

real_audio_73.krumhansl_reference: 37/73 modal, 52/73 in-set — sidecar beats the neural-free reference on all axes
real_audio_73.offset_histogram: peaks at 0 with 7/5 (dominant/subdominant) tail — no frame-origin pathology
